grouping_note: Groups are deterministic triage only. likely_clean means no configured automatic flag was detected; it does not assert semantic correctness.

flag_definitions.code_like_slug: Slug is exactly br, hr, or url: a deterministic HTML/web/code token list.
flag_definitions.very_short_slug: Slug length is two characters or fewer.
flag_definitions.bangla_equals_english: Trimmed, case-normalized Bangla value equals the English word.
flag_definitions.generic_example: Example exactly matches one of five corpus template sentences using the entry word.
flag_definitions.grammar_pattern_suspect: Example exactly matches “This is a <word>.”, a mechanically detectable article template requiring review.
flag_definitions.proper_noun_like: A synonym equals the entry word case-insensitively but uses capitalization, providing source-level proper-name evidence.
flag_definitions.synonym_contains_self: At least one normalized synonym equals the normalized entry word.
flag_definitions.duplicate_synonyms: Two or more synonyms are identical after trimming and case normalization.
flag_definitions.definition_mentions_different_term_if_de: For a one/two-character slug, the definition explicitly contains a longer non-self synonym.

grouping_rules.needs_human_review: One or more non-reject automatic flags and no likely-reject flag.
